title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection | Fire Engine Red | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch | Allied Brass, Fire Engine Red
description:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass for reliable everyday use in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space. Designed as part of the Carolina Collection, this straight bar helps keep towels within reach while saving space.

Highlights:
- Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Mounting plates and installation hardware included
- Coordinates with other versatile bath accessories in the Carolina Collection

Specs:
- Collection: Carolina Collection
- Style: Traditional
- Bar shape: Straight bar
- Center-to-center: 30 in
- Bar diameter: 0.75 in
- Overall size: 30 in L x 2 in W x 3.5 in H
- Projection: 2 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Included: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
Multiple designer finishes available
